description: The employer’s fault stops the work: the day stays scheduled and attended, and the full contract wage is paid for the stoppage.

references.title: Labour Code art.99(1); counted service, Decree 145/2020 art.65(9)

description: Another worker’s fault stops the work: the day stays scheduled and attended. The agreed stoppage wage is paid, but not below the regional minimum daily wage; unrecorded is the full contract day wage.

Utility failure, natural disaster, fire, epidemic, enemy action, State-ordered relocation or economic reasons stop the work: the day stays scheduled and attended. The agreed stoppage wage is paid, and for the first 14 working days it is not below the regional minimum daily wage.
A worker on strike is scheduled but not attended. The strike is unpaid unless the parties agree otherwise; unrecorded is no pay.
A strike stops a worker who does not take part: the day stays scheduled and attended. The agreed stoppage wage is paid as for another worker’s fault, at least the regional minimum daily wage.
